item.title: How to Read Your Electric Bill (Line by Line Guide)
item.description:
Your electric bill arrives every month. You look at the total, pay it, and move on. But that bill contains valuable information — and possibly errors costing you money. Here’s how to read every line. Learn more in Budget Billing Explained.
